headline: VINCE STAPLES TAKES CRY BABY TO AUSTRALIA
caption:
Vince Staples is bringing the Cry Baby Tour to Australia in January 2027, with headline shows in Perth, Brisbane, Sydney and Melbourne. The run follows his Beyond the Valley festival appearance and marks his first solo Australian dates in nearly a decade. His official website lists the stops, with Billboard and ABC Double J confirming the four-city run.

Sources: Vince Staples official website, Billboard and ABC Double J
https://www.vincestaples.co/
